entries.surface: MCP + CLI test coverage / feature-proof audit surface (plate_perform_test_coverage_audit) for Epic #350 / #363
entries.migration_impact: Agents and orchestrators can now call plate_perform_test_coverage_audit (dry_run first) to get live classification + gap suggestions tied to documented claims (Goals, SPEC beta, designs). Supports the repeatable audit method and Acceptance Evidence conventions from #350/#361/#362. Downstream repos inherit via plate-mcp and template updates. Complements information_audit and health surfaces.
entries.agent_notes: Prefer early in sessions on beta roadmap Epics or when health/claims drift suspected. Use dry_run=True for inspection; the report includes counts, gaps with related_claims + suggested_tests, and refs to the #361 artifacts. Follow with #364 for gap-closing tests + doc Evidence updates. See dogfood outputs in session comments on #350/#363 for example reports. Update both the tool and the inventory/audit docs on future claim or test changes (with fragment).

entries.migration_impact: Downstream PLATE repositories should add the Task label, the Task issue template, updated issue-type enforcement, and the Task closure marker rule.
entries.agent_notes: Use Task for human-only blockers or explicitly requested human action items. When closing a Task, add a short visible completion note plus the <!-- PLATE-TASK-CLOSED --> marker and avoid leaking secrets.
migration_guidance: 1. Copy the updated .github/labels.yml, .github/workflows/label-check.yml, and .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/task.yml into your repository.
2. Update AGENTS.md and .agentic/process.yml so Task is treated as a first-class issue type with milestone inheritance but no required Epic label.
3. Allow Task issues to close with a completion comment containing <!-- PLATE-TASK-CLOSED --> instead of requiring a PR, unless repository truth changed.

entries.migration_impact: Downstream PLATE repositories that want marketplace-based Copilot CLI installation should add a .github/plugin/marketplace.json manifest, document the marketplace registration/install commands, and keep the plugin runtime prerequisite explicit.
entries.agent_notes: For PLATE marketplace installs, prefer the marketplace flow over direct repo-path commands in public docs. Keep the runtime prerequisite (`plate-core` / `plate-mcp`) explicit until the plugin bundles or provisions it automatically.
migration_guidance: 1. Add .github/plugin/marketplace.json with a stable marketplace name and plugin source path.
2. Document the public install flow as: register marketplace, install plugin from marketplace, and separately install the runtime prerequisite if the plugin launches an external command.
3. Add a CI smoke test that exercises the intended pre-launch marketplace registration/install path.
